name: Kish
bio: Kish was the son of Abiel, of the tribe of Benjamin, Saul's father, and a man of standing. When some of his donkeys were lost, he sent his son Saul out with a servant to find them; Saul searched through the hill country of Ephraim, the land of Shalishah, the land of Shaalim, and the land of Benjamin without success, and finally came to the town where Samuel lived, where he was unexpectedly anointed king of Israel (1 Samuel 9:1-10:1). Kish himself plays no direct part in this scene, but it was the seemingly ordinary matter of his lost donkeys that became the remarkable circumstance through which the LORD arranged Saul's meeting with Samuel, launching Israel's history as a monarchy.
